consolidation.headline: Northwind Retail signs three-year contract and Contoso migration goes live early

facts: Priya Shah and Tom Evans signed Northwind Retail to a three-year managed service contract on 22 September.
Northwind's annual contract value is about 180 thousand pounds.
The Contoso migration went live on 20 September.
The migration finished two days early.
The Contoso team finished user training on 24 September.
Lucy Grey joined the service desk on 29 September.
Sam Patel covered the service desk over the bank holiday weekend.
Litware Supplies will raise the price of its business laptops by 5 per cent from 1 November.
Orders placed before 31 October will keep the current price.
Dan Wood celebrated his birthday on 2 October.
Tom Evans had a baby, Ava, on 25 September.
